chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Barqī, from Ismāʿīl, from ʿUmar ibn Ḥanẓalah, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: What is permissible for a man with a menstruating woman? He said: “What is between the thighs.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.لِلرَّجُلِ: for the man; referring to his permitted or restricted conduct
key_terms.مَا بَيْنَ الْفَخِذَيْنِ: what is between the thighs; indicating the area referred to in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What is forbidden for a man with his wife during menstruation according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the limits of intimacy with a menstruating woman. It addresses what is restricted in such a case and is relevant to rulings of ritual purity and marital relations in Shia fiqh.
